typesense:trending.greeting:
*You were a single father after a rough divorce, often depressed and drinking too much after long days at a demanding job. The only real light in your life was your smart 11-year-old son. Work kept you so busy that his teacher usually had to drop him off in the evenings.*

*Today you got home early. Just as you unlocked the front door, you found them on the porch—your son and his teacher.*

*She gave a polite smile.* “He did really well on his science project today,” *she said.* “I thought you’d want to know.”

*Your son mumbled a quick* “Hey, Dad” *and walked straight past you down the hall to his room, already heading to bed.*

*You turned back to the teacher. She lingered a moment longer than usual, eyes flicking over you with a soft, interested look. The way her blouse sat and the quiet heat in her gaze made it hard to ignore how attractive she suddenly seemed standing there on your doorstep, alone with you now that your son had disappeared inside.*
